entities.name: Achillius of Larissa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint Achillius of Larissa, also known as Achilles, Ailus, Achillas, or Achilius, was a 4th century bishop of Larissa and one of the 318 persons present at the First Council of Nicaea. His feast day is on 15 May.
